name: Cats
summary: Characters slide along walls with one call, and the editor gets a Notes panel for project Markdown files.
changes: MoveAndSlide moves a character, enemy or pushed crate through the collision world: it stops a skin short of walls and slides along them, also along slanted walls and round corners, and never passes through a collider. cornerAssist steps it into a nearby doorway. See Docs/Collision.md#moving-and-sliding and the WalkerSlide recipe.

Editor: a Notes panel opens the project's Notes/*.md files beside the Viewport. Assets has a Notes root to create, rename and delete notes; edits save on their own, and a note changed on disk reloads or asks which text to keep.
Agents are pointed at the engine's tools before they write their own: Agent.md lists what to look for first, and api finds more of the words agents use for a task.
Release notes give each engine version a name and a one-sentence summary. The launcher shows them, also for versions not downloaded yet.
